PART II
IMPOSITION  OF  SHARE  TRANSACTION  LEVY

7.
There  shall  be  imposed  with  effect  from  the  year
commencing on January 1, 2005 and for every year thereafter,
a levy to be called the Share Transaction Levy at the rate of
0.2 per centum from every buyer and seller, on the turnover
of every share trading transaction, which is conducted through
a Stock Exchange.
